rules.title: Measure BB: 5% cap on Annual General Adjustment (AGA)
rules.requirement: The Rent Board sets the AGA by the CPI-based formula in the Rent Ordinance, but the AGA approved for any year cannot exceed 5%. The cap does not stop landlords with banked (unused) AGAs from raising rent above 5% to reach the rent ceiling.
rules.exemptions: Cap does not prevent banked (unused) AGAs from previous years from being used to raise rent to the rent ceiling, even if the increase exceeds 5%.
rules.interaction: Banked AGAs may produce an increase greater than 5% up to the rent ceiling.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance (as amended by Measure BB)
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.

rules.title: Measure BB: Annual inflation adjustment of owner move-in eviction relocation assistance
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must adjust owner move-in eviction relocation assistance payment amounts for inflation every year.
rules.key_value: Annual inflationary adjustment of OMI relocation assistance
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance (as amended by Measure BB)
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.

rules.title: Security deposit cap (state AB 12): one month's rent
rules.requirement: Since July 1, 2024, most landlords may charge no more than one month's rent as a security deposit for furnished and unfurnished units. Last month's rent counts toward the deposit; first month's rent does not.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to furnished and unfurnished units; landlords not meeting the small-landlord criteria.
rules.exemptions: Small landlords (see BERK-DEP-02) may charge up to two months' rent.
rules.interaction: Last month's rent is considered part of the security deposit; first month's rent is not. Before July 1, 2024 the cap was two months (unfurnished) / three months (furnished).
rules.citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 (AB 12), as described by Berkeley Rent Board
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

rules.title: Small landlord exception: two months' rent deposit
rules.requirement: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total may charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units, if owned by a natural person, family trust, or an LLC whose members are all natural persons.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlord owns only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total; ownership by natural person, family trust, or LLC with all natural-person members.
rules.citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 (AB 12), as described by Berkeley Rent Board
rules.quoted_span: landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units

rules.title: Photograph unit at start of tenancy
rules.requirement: For tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document its condition.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy

rules.title: Move-out walk-through inspection
rules.requirement: Landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy so tenants can fix issues to avoid deposit deductions.
rules.quoted_span: landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify any items that need repair/cleaning

rules.title: Permitted security deposit deductions
rules.requirement: A landlord may deduct only amounts reasonably necessary to cover rent default, repair tenant-caused damage beyond normal wear and tear, clean the unit to its move-in level of cleanliness, and, if the lease allows, restore or replace personal property or furniture. Professional cleaning cannot be required unless reasonably necessary to restore move-in condition.
rules.coverage_conditions: Cleaning deduction applies to tenancies beginning after January 1, 2003.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord may deduct only the amount that is reasonably necessary to:

rules.title: Return of deposit within 21 days with itemized statement
rules.requirement: The remaining deposit must be returned within 21 days after the tenant vacates. If deductions are made, the landlord must provide an itemized written statement with copies of documents showing charges; from Jan 1, 2025 proof that repairs were completed; and from April 1, 2025, after-possession photos and a written cost explanation.
rules.quoted_span: All or any remaining portion of a security deposit must be returned

rules.title: Security deposit interest under Berkeley Rent Ordinance
rules.requirement: For units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on security deposits at the end of each year, and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year end.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year
